## Quick Reference

1. All code in English
2. Mobile-first design (44px touch targets)
3. WCAG AA accessibility
4. Use design tokens only (no hardcoded colors/spacing)
5. Atomic component architecture
6. Max ~200 lines per file
7. TypeScript strict (no `any`)
8. SCSS Modules with BEM-light
9. Performance optimized
10. Intentional animations
11. Supabase RLS always on
12. Conventional commits
13. Jest tests

**Read `CLAUDE.md` for the full rules.**
